connector.name: Jsoncanvas
connector.registryDescription: Create, validate, edit, export (markdown/svg/png/mermaid), and search JSON Canvas files.
connector.summary: Hosted at jsoncanvas.mcpcentral.io over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.mcpcentral, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from the MCPCentral gateway (Microsoft Entra OAuth at login.mcpcentral.io). Canvases are stored per authenticated user.
